definitions.explanation: Hair that has been woven or braided into a pattern. Refers to any style of braiding, including single braids, twin braids, and French braids.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{編|あ}み{髪|がみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{似合|にあ}う→似合う：02134_niau⟧。
⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{編|あ}み{髪|がみ}にして⟦あげた→あげる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.english: I braided my daughter's hair for her.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{美容院|びよういん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{編|あ}み{髪|がみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ヘアアレンジ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had a braided hairstyle done at the salon for the wedding.

notes:
A compound of {編|あ}み (braiding, from ⟦{編|あ}む→編む：00002_amu⟧ to braid/knit) and ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧ (hair), with rendaku changing かみ to がみ. A general term for any braided hairstyle.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {編|あ}み{髪|がみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to braid one's hair
- {編|あ}み{髪|がみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ほどく→ほどく：10504_hodoku⟧: to undo a braid
- {編|あ}み{髪|がみ}⟦アレンジ→アレンジ：08148_arenji⟧: braided hair arrangement

TYPES OF BRAIDS:
- ⟦{三|み}つ{編|あ}み→三つ編み：18439_mitsuami⟧: three-strand braid (the most common type)
- ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧{編|あ}み: twin braids, pigtails
- フィッシュボーン: fishtail braid
- フレンチブレイド: French braid

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{三|み}つ{編|あ}み→三つ編み：18439_mitsuami⟧: three-strand braid — the specific basic braid technique
- ⟦おさげ→おさげ：20771_osage⟧: pigtails, braids hanging down — often associated with schoolgirls
- {編|あ}み{込|こ}み: cornrows, braids woven close to the scalp
